'''Erick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who was part of the contingent invited to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Alongside [[Flind]], he was ordered by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] to accompany the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] back to their [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'', in order to question the three unidentified sentries whom Solo had encountered earlier. By the time they arrived, however, the sentries had disappeared. Finding the situation suspicious, Solo ordered Erick and Flind to scan the ''Falcon's'' exterior with [[EnhanceScan general purpose scanner/Legends|EnhanceScan portable scanners]] for any tracking devices. Erick initially objected to the order, but relented after Solo casually remarked that he would report Erick's refusal to General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] and [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]].<ref name="COO" />
